articles.title: Trump says 'threat' led US to pull bombers from RAF Fairford
articles.description: The Pentagon confirmed on Sunday it had removed the B1 bombers from the base in England back to their home stations in America.

articles.title: What prompted the US bombers to leave RAF Fairford?
articles.description: The mass evacuation of American bombers from the UK points to concern in the Pentagon, our security correspondent writes.

articles.title: Author and former politician Jeffrey Archer dies aged 86
